citation_details.title: Auditory Cortex Macaque Monkey DISC Data
citation_details.author: Yoshinao Kajikawa, Charles Schroeder
citation_details.abstract: This dataset contains electrophysiological recordings from the auditory cortex of macaque monkeys, acquired using multi-channel electrode arrays. The data represents raw neural activity and provides a valuable resource for investigating the neural mechanisms underlying auditory cortical organization in non-human primates. This is a NEMAR mirror of the OpenNeuro dataset ds007028.

citation_details.title: Two new species of Pestalotiopsis (Amphisphaeriales, Pestalotiopsidaceae) causing needle blight of Pinus massoniana in China
citation_details.author: Hui Li, Yu-Qing Bai, Jun-Ya Xie, De‐Wei Li, Li-Hua Zhu
citation_details.abstract: Pinus massoniana Lamb. is an important tree species widely used for afforestation and industrial timber on barren hills in China. Needle blight of P. massoniana , caused by Pestalotiopsis spp., is widespread and occurs over a large area. In this study, 10 representative strains were isolated from diseased needles of P. massoniana in Anhui and Guangxi provinces. Based on phylogenetic analysis of three genomic loci (ITS, TEF1 , and TUB2 ), combined with morphological characteristics, two new species— Pestalotiopsis liuzhouensis sp. nov. and Pestalotiopsis kendrickii sp. nov. —were identified. Pathogenicity experiments showed that these 10 representative strains were pathogenic to P. massoniana . This study enhances understanding of the diversity of pathogens causing P. massoniana needle blight and provides insights for future control strategies.
